tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: oxiguitar-guitarpro is a Rust workspace providing complete read and write support for Guitar Pro file formats (GP3 through GP8). It consists of a core formats crate and five thin plugin crates, with extensive testing across all supported formats.

tour.title: Core Library Entry Point
tour.description: The main library re-exports the public API: read() for importing songs from any supported format, write_gp() for GP/GPIF export, write_gp5() for GP5 export, and format detection utilities.

tour.title: Binary Format Readers (GP3/GP4/GP5)
tour.description: The gp module provides a binary reader for Guitar Pro 3, 4, and 5 formats. It uses the binary module for low-level I/O and parses song structure, tracks, beats, notes, and musical effects directly from binary data.

tour.title: XML/GPIF Format Readers (GP6/GP7/GP8)
tour.description: The gpif module reads Guitar Pro 6+ formats (GPX and .gp files) which use XML-based Guitar Pro Interchange Format. It includes an XML parser, effects handler, and container support for ZIP archives.

tour.title: Format Writers
tour.description: Two writer modules: GP5 writer for binary GP5 output, and GP/GPIF writer for Guitar Pro 6+ XML output. Both serialize the oxiguitar-model song representation back to their respective formats.

tour.title: Plugin Architecture
tour.description: Five plugin crates (gp3, gp4, gp5, gpx, gp) each provide a thin wrapper over the corresponding oxiguitar-formats reader, implementing the oxiguitar-plugin-api trait. Each plugin is feature-gated to only include its own reader, keeping binary size minimal.

tour.title: Testing Infrastructure
tour.description: Comprehensive test suite including round-trip tests (read then write, verify), corpus tests (read all known files), format-specific tests, host integration tests, and fuzz testing targets for crash discovery.

tour.title: Fixture Coverage
tour.description: Extensive fixture sets covering all musical features: notes, rests, bends, vibrato, harmonics, chords, dynamics, articulations, repeats, tempo changes, layout options, and more. Organized into gp (multi-format), guitar-pro-check (feature pairs), guitar-pro-7.6 (GP7-specific), and reference (canonical GP files).
